title: FlashCart: Flash-Sale Inventory
context: During a flash sale thousands of add-to-cart events hit in minutes. The store must avoid overselling and spot bots.
input: Events: user id, product id, quantity, timestamp; stock per product; coupon values.

milestones.title: Bot detection
milestones.requirement: Users placing repeated orders (count array over user ids).

milestones.title: Fewest coupons
milestones.requirement: Fewest coupons of values {50, 100, 200} that make an exact discount (coin change).

milestones.title: Units sold in any minute range
milestones.requirement: Prefix sums over units per minute.

milestones.title: Bundle offers
milestones.requirement: Two products whose prices sum exactly to the bundle price: sort and two pointers.

milestones.title: Packing rate
milestones.requirement: Minimum orders packed per hour so every warehouse finishes within 6 hours.

milestones.title: Product page cache
milestones.requirement: Cache product pages with LRU eviction; report the hit ratio.
